canonical_name: Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP), RFC 792 generation
error_control: ICMP reports selected error conditions but suppresses recursive ICMP error generation; individual message types have distinct semantics.

operations.monitoring: Echo, unreachable, time-exceeded and other messages later become central to diagnostics/operations.
operations.diagnostics: ICMP Echo underlies ping-like diagnostics; time exceeded participates in traceroute-style diagnostics in later practice.
operations.failure_behavior: Generation is intentionally constrained to avoid error-message recursion and fragmented-datagram ambiguity.
operations.operator_interface: Router/host generation, rate-limit and filter controls vary by implementation and era.

open_questions: Build message type/code genealogy and deprecation map.
Trace Source Quench deployment and removal separately from TCP congestion-control history.
Recover first ping/traceroute implementations as software artifacts.
notes: Do not collapse ICMP into 'ping' or treat it as a peer application transport like TCP/UDP solely because it has an IP protocol number.
